people.name: Jay Christensen
people.bio: American drone pilot whose one-shot FPV flight through a bowling alley made cinematic FPV widely known.

milestones.event: Flew the one-shot FPV film Right Up Our Alley in Minneapolis.

Spoke at Figma Config 2025.
